description: Compares a US federal student loan across every repayment plan the borrower is actually eligible for — RAP (Repayment Assistance Plan), IBR, ICR, PAYE, SAVE, Graduated, Extended and the tiered Standard plan — returning the monthly payment and lifetime cost for each, plus which plans are excluded and the eligibility rule that excludes them. A balance and income are enough: when the interest rate is not known (a linked account often shows the balance only), omit ratePct and the federal rate for the loan type is used and stated. Set loansMadeOnOrAfterJuly2026 when the loans are new, so only the plans new loans can elect are priced. Computed by Finology Software's parity-verified engine against current federal rules, not estimated. Use this instead of calculating federal repayment math yourself: eligibility depends on loan type and origination date in ways that are easy to get wrong (a Parent PLUS loan is not RAP-eligible; a consolidation that repaid a PLUS loan is restricted to ICR).

balance.description: Current federal loan balance in dollars.

borrowerAgi.description: Borrower's adjusted gross income in dollars, annual.

dependents.description: Number of qualifying dependents. A spouse is NOT a dependent.

filingStatus.description: Tax filing status: single, mfj (married filing jointly), mfs (married filing separately), hoh (head of household).

loanType.description: Federal loan type. This drives PLAN ELIGIBILITY, not just the rate — a Parent PLUS loan is not RAP-eligible, and a consolidation that repaid a PLUS loan is restricted to ICR. Choose accurately.

loansMadeOnOrAfterJuly2026.description: Optional, default false. Set true when the borrower says the loans are new: first disbursed (or consolidated) on or after July 1, 2026. New loans can elect only RAP and the tiered Standard plan (Parent PLUS: the tiered Standard plan only), so leaving this false for new loans offers plans they cannot elect.

ratePct.description: Optional. Weighted average interest rate as a percentage, e.g. 6.54 for 6.54%. Omit it when the rate is not known (a linked account often shows the balance only): the 2026-27 federal rate for loanType is then used and stated in the answer (undergraduate Direct 6.52%, PLUS 9.07%; for graduate or professional Direct Unsubsidized loans pass 8.07). Required for a consolidation loan, which has no federal rate.

spouseAgi.description: Spouse's annual AGI. Only used when filingStatus is mfj.
